events.title: Prior mammogram (Feb 2022) — no mass
events.summary: A prior bilateral mammogram from February 2022 was used for comparison. The current right breast mass was not present on that prior study.

source.snippet: The mass is new compared to the 02/2022 prior. No associated calcifications. No skin or nipple retraction. No axillary lymphadenopathy.

events.title: OB/GYN annual visit — unremarkable
events.summary: Routine annual gynecologic visit with Dr. Karen Wu. Breast and pelvic exams were normal with no masses, discharge, or concerning findings.

source.snippet: Annual GYN visit. Pt c/o no breast complaints. Breast exam: no masses palpated bilaterally. Plan: routine screening mammogram.

events.title: Pap + HPV co-test performed
events.summary: Cervical cancer screening with a combined Pap smear and HPV co-test was performed during today's visit. Results expected within 7 days.

source.snippet: Pap + HPV co-test performed today. Last normal co-test 02/15/2023. Will report results within 7 days.

events.title: Referral — screening mammogram
events.summary: Referred to Breast Imaging Center for a routine screening mammogram, due now as the last one was over 24 months ago (February 2022).

source.snippet:
Refer to Breast Imaging Center for screening mammogram.
Last screening mammogram was 04-Feb-2022 (over the 24-month interval, due now).

events.title: Mammogram — BI-RADS 4 (suspicious), right breast
events.summary: Screening mammogram (with digital breast tomosynthesis) found a new 1.2 cm spiculated (irregular) mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position. This was rated BI-RADS 4 (suspicious), and a biopsy was recommended. The left breast was normal (BI-RADS 1).

source.snippet: FINDINGS: 1.2 cm spiculated mass identified in right breast at the 11 o'clock position, approx 3 cm from nipple. ASSESSMENT: BI-RADS 4 — Suspicious abnormality. Biopsy recommended.

events.title: Mammogram — BI-RADS 4 (suspicious), 1.2 cm right breast mass
events.summary: Routine screening mammogram at Westside Breast Imaging identified a new 1.2 cm spiculated (irregular) mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position. BI-RADS category 4 — suspicious; ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy recommended.

source.snippet: routine screening mammogram on 02/22/2024 (Westside Breast Imaging) demonstrating a new 1.2 cm spiculated mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position, approximately 3 cm from the nipple. BI-RADS 4. The radiologist recommended ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy.

events.title: Mammogram review — 1.2 cm spiculated mass, 11 o'clock
events.summary: Dr. Patel personally reviewed the February 22, 2024 mammogram and confirmed a 1.2 cm spiculated mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position, approximately 3 cm from the nipple.

source.snippet: Personally reviewed the 02/22/2024 mammogram on PACS. Confirmed a 1.2 cm spiculated mass in the right breast, in the 11 o'clock position, approximately 3 cm from the nipple.

events.title: Prior screening mammogram — BI-RADS 4 (suspicious)
events.summary: A screening mammogram on this date identified a new 1.2 cm spiculated mass in the right breast at the 11 o'clock position, rated BI-RADS 4 (suspicious), which prompted the biopsy.

source.snippet: new 1.2 cm spiculated mass in right breast at 11 o'clock, 3 cm from nipple, identified on screening mammogram dated 02/22/2024. BI-RADS 4.

events.title: Patient notified of mammogram findings by phone
events.summary: Patient was informed by phone of the suspicious mammogram finding and expressed a desire to proceed with next steps promptly.

source.snippet: Patient was informed of the finding by phone on 02/26/2024 and is anxious to proceed promptly.

events.title: Referral to Breast Surgery — suspicious right breast mass
events.summary: Dr. Karen Wu referred Maria to Dr. Anil Patel (Breast Surgery, UCSF) for evaluation of a suspicious right breast mass found on mammogram, with a request for ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy.

source.snippet: Refer to Dr. Patel, Breast Surgery, for evaluation of suspicious mass r/o malignancy.

events.title: Breast surgery consult — suspicious right breast mass
events.summary: New consultation with Dr. Anil Patel (Breast Surgery) following a suspicious mammogram result. Physical exam found no palpable mass; imaging was personally reviewed and confirmed a 1.2 cm spiculated mass at the 11 o'clock position of the right breast.

source.snippet: Pt seen in consultation for s/p suspicious mammogram. Reviewed images. Plan: schedule core needle biopsy for next week.

events.title: Dx: Suspicious right breast mass, BI-RADS 4
events.summary: Right breast mass classified as BI-RADS 4 (suspicious), requiring tissue biopsy to determine whether the finding is benign (such as fibroadenoma) or malignant (such as invasive ductal carcinoma).

source.snippet: Suspicious right breast mass, BI-RADS 4 — needs tissue diagnosis. Risk factors are limited (second-degree family hx only, peri-menopausal age, dense breast tissue). Differential includes fibroadenoma vs. invasive ductal carcinoma vs. other benign etiology.

events.title: Scheduled: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy, right breast
events.summary: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy of the right breast 11 o'clock mass was scheduled for March 28, 2024. Risks were reviewed with the patient, who consented in principle.

source.snippet: Procedure: ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy of right breast 11 o'clock mass scheduled for 03/28/2024.

events.title: Core needle biopsy — right breast, benign
events.summary: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy of the right breast mass (11 o'clock position) was performed. Pathology returned benign — fibroadenoma, with no evidence of malignancy.

source.snippet: Pathology: Right breast mass, ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy. DIAGNOSIS: Fibroadenoma, no evidence of malignancy.

events.title: Pathology confirmed: right breast fibroadenoma
events.summary: Pathology from the March 28, 2024 core needle biopsy returned on April 3, 2024, confirming a fibroadenoma (a benign breast growth) with no evidence of malignancy.

source.snippet: Pathology returned on April 3, 2024 demonstrating a fibroadenoma with no evidence of malignancy.

events.title: OB/GYN follow-up — post benign biopsy debrief
events.summary: Follow-up visit with Dr. Wu to discuss the benign (fibroadenoma) right breast biopsy result. Biopsy site was well-healed on exam; no new masses or lymphadenopathy found.

source.snippet: Pt returns to discuss benign biopsy result. Reassured. Will resume routine annual screening mammogram.
